creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster msg post --to @human "<text>" --option A --option B` posted the flags as body text, so the question went out with no answers to tap. `muster msg post --to hippo "..." --help`, run to reread the options, sent the text plus a literal `--help` and woke the recipient. A post cannot be recalled.

crates/muster-cli/src/messaging.rs:149 declares TEXT with `trailing_var_arg = true`, so everything after the first word of text is text. Refuse text holding one of post's own flags or `--help`, or stop treating the rest as text once a flag-shaped word follows. Text that really contains such a word keeps a way through: `--file` or `--`.
title: `msg post` takes flags after its text as message text, and `--help` there sends the post
